actual_hs_list: 382290 (reference/impurity standards, working standards, nitrosamine & metabolite standards — primary line); 294200 / 2933xx-2941xx (API impurity standards & metabolites of specific drug substances, e.g. Levofloxacin Related Compound A, Irbesartan, Imatinib, Itraconazole); 284590 (stable isotope labelled compounds, 13C/15N/D labelled); 382219 (in-vitro diagnostic / bio-analytical standards); 2934xx/2924xx/2918xx/2916xx (custom-synthesised research chemicals, mg-to-kg scale, code depends on the individual molecule); 2501/3822 not applicable
product_summary: Website (simsonpharma.com, home + /products/impurity-standards) shows the real product lines: (1) Pharmaceutical Reference Standards / Working Standards; (2) Impurity Standards — catalogue indexed by parent API (Ibandronate, Ibrutinib, Ibuprofen, Imatinib, Irbesartan, Itraconazole, Isoniazid, Ivacaftor, etc.), sold in 100 mg packs (e.g. 'Levofloxacin Related Compound A 100mg — Rs 45,600'); (3) Stable Isotope Labelled Compounds; (4) Metabolites; (5) Nitrosamine Impurities; (6) Controlled Substance standards; (7) Labelled Reagent Products; (8) Peptide Impurities; (9) Research Chemicals and Custom Synthesis (mg to Kg scale, 1 mg–1 kg output, bench-scale hoods, 10 ml–5000 ml reactors). Corporate office: The Platina Building, Dahisar East, Mumbai 400068, Maharashtra; R&D/custom-synthesis lab at Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana. Group companies: SimSon Chemtech, SimSon Chemie, SimSon Pharma Services. Export contact: exports@simsonpharma.com.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — in-house custom synthesis and purification labs (Hyderabad) plus a very broad reseller-style catalogue of thousands of impurity standards across hundreds of APIs, which is typical of a standards supplier that synthesises part of the range and sources the rest. No trader-only signs (own labs, own analytical suite: HPLC, GC-HS, FTIR, LCMS, ICPMS, TGA, PSD).
comment: Industry misclassification: declared as 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals), but the company is a pharma analytical-standards / impurity-reference-standard producer and custom-synthesis house — it belongs to pharma/lab-reagents, not oil & gas. HS mismatch is total: declared codes 291639 (aromatic monocarboxylic acids), 291813 (tartaric acid salts/esters), 292390 (quaternary ammonium salts/hydroxides) and 292419 (acyclic amides/derivatives) are bulk commodity organic chemicals and do not describe the actual business at all. The real trade is micro-quantity, high-value reference standards, which classify under 3822 (diagnostic/lab reagents, certified reference materials) — 382290 is the correct primary HS-6 — with the individual impurity/metabolite molecules potentially falling under their own specific chapters (2933/2934/2941/2924/2918/2916) and isotope-labelled compounds under 2845. Per project rule 3, this is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, code corrected to 382290 as the principal line, with the molecule-specific codes as secondary. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: reference/working standards, impurity standards, nitrosamine standards, stable isotope labelled compounds, metabolites, peptide impurities, custom-synthesis research chemicals. All product data above is from the company's own website and catalogue only — no customs line was available to me in this task, so the actual shipment composition is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. PAN ABACS1984P and legal name were not verified here (out of scope for this role).
